snippet.title: Sculplings | Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the world of Sculplings! Here, trainers collect and battle a random assortment of hand-sculpted monsters in order to become the #1 Sculpling Champion! Sculplings is a mashup of roguelikes with traditional monster fighter games!

Wishlist today and sign up for the closed beta! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062680/Sculplings/?beta=1
